message.content:
A medium-sized apple (about 182 g or roughly 3 inches across) contains approximately **95 calories**.  
If you’re looking at different sizes:

| Size (approx.) | Weight (g) | Calories |
|----------------|------------|----------|
| Small (≈150 g) | ~80–90 kcal |
| Medium (≈182 g)| ~95 kcal |
| Large (≈250 g) | ~115–120 kcal |

These figures assume a standard “red” or “green” apple with no added sugars or toppings. If you’re counting exact calories for a specific variety or brand, it’s best to check the nutrition label or use a reliable database like the USDA FoodData Central.
